text: Memtrace 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的代码智能图谱插件，通过 Cordis bundle 接入 Memtrace MCP，并在 DSH 注册随包提供的代码分析技能。连接 MCP 后，agent 可使用代码索引、符号与代码搜索、符号上下文、影响范围和演化查询等工具；技能覆盖项目探索、代码审查与多 agent 协作。插件使用 stdio 启动 memtrace mcp，默认由 npx 提供启动命令，也可用 MEMTRACE_BIN 指定已有程序。适合需要在 DSH 会话中查找和理解代码库的开发者；需安装 Node.js 和 Memtrace MCP 程序。

Memtrace connects DSH to Memtrace MCP and registers bundled code skills. Agents can index repositories, search code and symbols, inspect change impact, and query code evolution. The bundle launches memtrace mcp over stdio, using npx or MEMTRACE_BIN. Requires Node.js and the Memtrace MCP program.

Help me understand how this codebase is organized and what changed over time.
Memtrace 的代码查询：插件配置 Memtrace MCP 的 stdio 客户端，发现后可在 DSH 中调用仓库索引、符号搜索、代码搜索和演化等工具。
注册随包技能：插件读取 skills 目录中的 SKILL.md，将解析出的名称、说明和正文注册到 DSH skills；卸载时调用注册返回的清理函数。

dsh-plugin-memtrace README · Install & uninstall：| Channel | Command |
| --- | --- |
| Git (`main`) | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:syncable-dev/dsh-plugin-memtrace#main` |
| npm | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-memtrace` |
| Local checkout | `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-memtrace` |
| Uninstall | `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-memtrace` |

This package is plain ESM — no `prepare` script, no `allowBuilds` prompt.

dsh-plugin-memtrace README · How it works：```mermaid
flowchart LR
  DSH[DeepSeek Harness] --> Bundle[dsh-plugin-memtrace]
  Bundle --> Skills[ctx.skills.register]
  Bundle --> MCP["@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"]

Two Cordis rows, both owned by this bundle:

1. **`dsh-plugin-memtrace`** — reads `skills/*/SKILL.md` and registers each skill at apply time. Unload disposes them.
2. **`mcp-memtrace`** — official MCP client, `serverName: memtrace`, stdio. `MEMTRACE_BIN` overrides the command; otherwise `npx -y memtrace mcp`.
dsh-plugin-memtrace README · How it works：We do **not** patch the filesystem skill provider's config. That row is last-write-wins; runtime registration does not collide with other skill packs.
dsh-plugin-memtrace README · Tools the model gets：After MCP discovery, every Memtrace tool is a native DSH tool under `mcp__memtrace__*`. The ones agents use first:

dsh-plugin-memtrace README · Tools the model gets：| Tool | Use when |
| --- | --- |
| `list_indexed_repositories` | Check what is already in the graph |
| `index_directory` | First contact with a repo |
| `find_symbol` / `find_code` | Locate a function, type, or behavior |
| `get_symbol_context` | Callers, callees, community |
| `get_impact` | Blast radius before an edit |
| `get_evolution` | What changed, and when |
| `recall_decision` | Why odd-looking code is there |

dsh-plugin-memtrace README · Permissions & data：- Spawns `memtrace mcp` in the session working directory (reads the repo to index; writes `.memdb` next to the project).
- Registers skills from this package only.
- Does not send code to Memtrace cloud. Local graph.
